text_model.name: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
text_model.description: Lightweight sentence-transformer optimised for semantic similarity. Used by the ingestion worker to embed text chunks and by the search worker to vectorise queries.

image_model.name: nomic-ai/nomic-embed-vision-v1.5
image_model.description: CLIP-compatible vision model producing 384-dim vectors aligned with nomic-embed-text. Input must be a 224x224 RGB JPEG image (preprocessed by ImageHandler).
